findings.title: Diff-trimming can throw StringIndexOutOfBoundsException
findings.body: In verifySafeHtml the code trims common prefix/suffix with `start`/`end` loops and then does `value.substring(start, value.length() - end)`. `start` and `end` are computed independently against `min(len)` and can overlap, e.g. value="aa" vs sanitized="aaa" gives start=2, end=2 so `substring(2, 0)` throws. Since verify() is run for every message bundle, one such pair crashes the whole theme-verifier instead of reporting illegal HTML.

findings.title: verifySafeHtml throws RuntimeException instead of MojoExecutionException
findings.body: If the derived English file or the checked file cannot be read, verifySafeHtml throws `new RuntimeException(...)`. The caller verify() only translates IOException to MojoExecutionException, so a missing English counterpart or unreadable bundle aborts the Maven build with an unwrapped stack trace instead of a proper Mojo error message.

findings.title: Anchor stripping makes HTML policy over-permissive and order-sensitive
findings.body:
santizeAnchors removes exactly-matching `` tags from the translation before selecting `POLICY_SOME_HTML` vs `POLICY_NO_HTML`. If the English source contains only ``, containsHtml() is true so any `/

/
/` in the translation is then accepted, even though the source never allowed those tags. The sequential `matcher.find()/englishMatcher.find()` also requires identical order and count and mutates `value` while iterating the old Matcher, so reordered or duplicated anchors are mishandled.

findings.title: Duplicate-key check misses valid properties syntax
findings.body: verifyNoDuplicateKeys only skips lines starting exactly with `#` and splits on `=`. Java properties also allow `:` as separator, leading whitespace before comments, escaped separators, and `\` continuations. Duplicates using those forms will not be detected, so the verifier gives false confidence.

findings.title: Lithuanian message replaced with Italian text
findings.body: The change replaces totpStep1 with `Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:` which is Italian, not Lithuanian. The same Italian sentence was also put into themes login messages_lt.properties. Someone reading only the Lithuanian bundle will see a foreign language, indicating a copy-paste error while stripping HTML links.

findings.title: Simplified-Chinese file now contains Traditional characters
findings.body: totpStep1 was changed to `在您的手機上安裝以下應用程式之一：` using Traditional forms手機/應用程式/之一 while the file is messages_zh_CN (Simplified, which should use 手机/应用程序). This suggests the wrong locale variant was pasted when removing the FreeOTP links.
